render.laterWidget: “{{type}}” widget arrives in a later phase

library.description: Images, videos and audio for your screens. Your plan includes {{limit}} GB of storage.
library.emptyBody: Upload images (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF), videos (MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV) or audio. Drag files onto this page or use Upload media.
library.unsupported: This file type is not supported.
library.deleteBody: The file is removed permanently. Files used in a layout or playlist cannot be deleted.
library.name: Name
library.tagsHint: Separate with commas, e.g. menu, diwali
library.pickEmpty: No ready files of this type yet.

studio.description: Design multi-zone layouts for landscape and portrait screens.
studio.deleteBody: {{name}} will be deleted. Layouts used in a playlist cannot be deleted.
studio.emptyBody: Start from a template, then place media, text, clocks and QR codes in its zones.
studio.name: Layout name
studio.resolutionHint: Match your LED controller’s output. Portrait templates swap width and height.
studio.previewHint: Preview at {{w}}×{{h}} · Press Esc to close
studio.leaveTitle: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
studio.laterWidgets: More widgets (table, web page, weather, RSS, air quality, gauge, chart, status) are under Content in the zone’s properties.
studio.canvasHint: {{w}}×{{h}} · Drag to move, use handles to resize · Arrow keys nudge (Shift = 5%) · Delete removes
studio.selectHint: Select a zone on the canvas or in Layers to edit it.
studio.fitHint: Cover fills the zone and may crop; Contain shows everything with bars.
studio.playlistHint: Only playlists without layouts can play inside a zone.
studio.noZonePlaylists: Create a playlist of images or videos first.
studio.textHint: Hindi, Marathi and other scripts are supported.
studio.qrHint: A web address, phone number or any text.
studio.urlHint: https:// only. Some websites refuse to be shown inside other pages.
studio.tableHintGrid: Up to 10 columns and 50 rows. The first row is the heading.
studio.tableSensorHint: Up to 10 columns and 50 rows. Use the sensor button in a cell to show a live sensor value with its unit.

playlists.description: Sequences of media, layouts and widgets that play in a loop.
playlists.emptyBody: A playlist plays its items in order and loops. Schedules decide when each playlist plays.
playlists.name: Playlist name
playlists.deleteBody: {{name}} will be deleted. Playlists used by a layout or schedule cannot be deleted.
playlists.noItems: Add media, layouts or widgets to build the playlist.
playlists.previewHint: Loops through the items with their durations.
playlists.noLayouts: Create a layout in Layout Studio first.
playlists.widgetHint: Widgets fill the whole screen when played from a playlist.

schedules.description: Decide which playlist plays where and when. Higher priority wins when schedules overlap.
schedules.needPlaylist: Create a playlist first; schedules play playlists.
schedules.emptyBody: A schedule plays a playlist on chosen screens at chosen times. Screens follow it once they are paired and you publish.
schedules.name: Name
schedules.noTargets: None created yet — add them under Sites & Groups.
schedules.overnightHint: An end time before the start runs past midnight.
schedules.priorityHint: 0–100. Use 50+ for promotions that should override regular content.
schedules.conflictsTitle: Overlapping schedules with the same priority
schedules.conflict: “{{a}}” and “{{b}}” overlap (first at {{at}}). Give one a higher priority so screens know which to play.
schedules.nothing: Nothing scheduled — screens show their default content.
schedules.testHint: Uses the same rules the screens use, including time zones and priorities.

types.billing_trial_ending: Your free trial ends on {{until, date}}
types.billing_due_soon: Your subscription renews on {{until, date}}: payment is due
types.billing_past_due: Payment is overdue: renew within the grace period to avoid interruption
types.billing_restricted: Subscription lapsed: editing and publishing are paused
types.support_access_requested: WallX support asks for access for {{hours}} h: {{reason}}
types.support_access_granted: WallX gave its support team emergency access for {{hours}} h: {{reason}}

emergency.title: Emergency override
emergency.intro: This immediately replaces normal content on the selected screens until you end it or the time runs out. Every step is recorded in the audit log.
emergency.name: Reason
emergency.namePlaceholder: e.g. Fire drill, Store closing early
emergency.messageHint: Large text on a coloured background. Hindi and Marathi are supported.
emergency.impact_one: {{count}} screen will switch within about 30 seconds.
emergency.impact_other: {{count}} screens will switch within about 30 seconds.

commands.title: Remote control
commands.notInPlan: Remote commands are not included in your plan.
commands.queued: “{{command}}” sent. The player picks it up within about 30 seconds.

confirmBody.restart_app: The screen goes black for a few seconds while the player restarts.
confirmBody.reboot: The box restarts (only on boxes set up as a kiosk; otherwise the player restarts). The screen is blank for up to a minute.
confirmBody.clear_cache: All downloaded media is deleted and downloaded again. The screen may be blank until the download finishes.
confirmBody.install_update: Android’s install prompt appears on the screen. Someone at the screen must select Install; the player then restarts with the new version.

approvals.hint: Approving publishes the current content of layouts, playlists and schedules — preview them first.

screens.rotationHint: For a portrait LED wall driven by a landscape HDMI output, choose 90° or 270° (whichever matches how the wall is mounted). The player turns everything it shows.
screens.sentForApproval: Publishing needs approval in this organization. Your request was sent to the approvers.
screens.description: Android players connected to your LED walls and displays.
screens.published_one: Published to {{count}} screen. It updates within about 30 seconds.
screens.published_other: Published to {{count}} screens. They update within about 30 seconds.
screens.publishHint: Changes to layouts, playlists and schedules reach screens when you publish. Screens keep playing their last published content while offline.
screens.emptyBody: Install the WallX Play Player app on the Android box, open it, then add the screen here with the code it shows.
screens.name: Screen name
screens.pairHelp: Open the WallX Play Player app on the screen. It shows a 6-character pairing code — or scan its QR code with your phone to open this form with the code filled in.
screens.recentErrors: Recent errors reported by the player
screens.removeBody: The screen is removed and its player is disconnected permanently. To use the box again, reset the app and pair it as a new screen.

groups.title: Screen groups
groups.description: Group screens (for example “Lobby walls” or “All Pune stores”) to schedule them together.
groups.name: Group name
groups.deleteBody: {{name}} will be deleted. Groups with screens or schedules cannot be deleted.
